say:1:1030226001:0.text:
During the courtship, I secretly took care of some of her troubles.
But she thought it was a genie, like in those tales, who helped her all this time.

say:2:1030226002:0.text: After all the hardships, her heart remains pure. This is what I love about her the most!
say:2:1030226002:0.source_cn: 即便经历过许多磨难，却仍然纯真，这正是她吸引我的地方！

say:3:1030226003:0.text:
At least I know that she took my hand for love, not out of gratitude...
He-he. I feel even happier now.
say:3:1030226003:0.source_cn: 而且这样看来，她答应我的追求是因为喜欢我，而不是因为我...
